patch_description: This crossover retains the current program’s symmetry-preserving Möbius CZ network while adopting the stronger prior program’s single shared circuit parameter, ring-based ZZ correlation layer, and readout-aligned CRZ layer. Sharing one angle across all parameterized gates reduces the model from four total parameters to three, improving parameter efficiency and few-shot regularization. The fixed CZ network supplies parameter-free local and long-range mixing, while ZZ and CRZ operations directly emphasize pair correlations relevant to the fixed two-qubit readout. The unchanged training and evaluation code preserves all original inputs and outputs.
